lines.zh: 我慢悠悠地踱着，一步一沉。
lines.en: I pace slowly, heavy with each step.

lines.zh: 螺纹的壳体在水里转得很慢。
lines.en: My spiraled shell turns slowly in the water.

lines.zh: 我一挪动，海底的沙就散开。
lines.en: When I move, the seabed sand scatters.
I push forward along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 这具壳太重了，我走不快。
lines.en: This shell is too heavy; I can't go fast.

lines.zh: 我把凿形的足伸出去探路。
lines.en: I extend my chisel-like foot to feel the way.
I slowly turn my shell's opening.

lines.zh: 深海的路上，我一步不落。
lines.en: On the deep-sea road, I miss no step.
I slide slowly down from the ledge.

lines.zh: 水被我的巨大壳体撑开。
lines.en: Water is pushed apart by my great shell.
I stop, shell mouth facing outward.
An ancient snail like me is best at waiting.

lines.zh: 壳里的肉在极缓地搏动。
lines.en: The flesh in my shell pulses very slowly.

lines.zh: 周围的水压着我，很舒服。
lines.en: The water pressure presses pleasantly.

lines.zh: 我把凿足收回去，歇一歇。
lines.en: I draw my chisel foot in and rest.

lines.zh: 这片深海，安静得像空壳。
lines.en: This deep sea is quiet as an empty shell.

lines.zh: 我的一层层螺纹，数得清年份。
lines.en: My shell's rings can be counted as years.

lines.zh: 我不用追，猎物自己会来。
lines.en: I needn't chase; prey comes to me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张开壳口，又合上。
lines.en: I slowly open my shell mouth and close it.

lines.zh: 很长时间，我什么都没做。
lines.en: For a long while I do nothing.
My armor is absurdly thick.

lines.zh: 我在听远处礁石的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the reef far away.

lines.zh: 沉在这里，我和石头差不多。
lines.en: Sunk here, I match the stone.

lines.zh: 我等着潮水替我带来吃食。
lines.en: I let the tide bring me food.
This form of mine carries weight.
I dim and go quiet.

lines.zh: 我这辈子没见过这种小东西。
lines.en: In my long life I've not seen such a small thing.
I slowly turn my shell mouth toward you.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我壳上，很小。
lines.en: Your shadow on my shell is tiny.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，也能感觉到你。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I sense you.

lines.zh: 你站得离我的护甲太近。
lines.en: You stand too near my armor.

lines.zh: 我这身厚壳，你敲不动的。
lines.en: This thick shell won't yield to your knocking.
I'm deciding whether to bother with you.

lines.zh: 你身上有点暖，和深海不同。
lines.en: You carry warmth, unlike the deep.

lines.zh: 我把凿足伸出来，量了量你。
lines.en: I extend my foot and gauge you.

lines.zh: 很久没人敢这么看我了。
lines.en: No one has dared look at me like this in ages.

lines.zh: 我听见你骨骼里的声音。
lines.en: I hear the sound inside your bones.
I'll take my time, unhurried.
A small crack in the shell; no matter.
That rang out quite loudly.
I slowly tighten my shell mouth.

lines.zh: 几百年来第一次这么疼。
lines.en: First pain like this in centuries.
My armor holds, so it's fine.
You found the crack; clever.
I back half a step and turn slowly.
I'll mend this myself.
I am not angry; I keep accounts.
Keep hitting and you'll tire too.
There's a taste, very faint.
I reach out slowly; don't rush.

lines.zh: 这东西不够塞我的壳口。
lines.en: This won't fill my shell mouth.
What you hold up — is it for me?
Moving over will take some time.
There's no such fragrance in the deep.
I'll accept it as an exchange.
This nourishment will last me a while.
I offer my chisel foot to take it.
You have patience; I like that.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的螺纹上，滑开了。
lines.en: You hit my shell's spiral and slid off.
This body is basically a reef.
Stop pushing; I don't move.

lines.zh: 你的力气对壳来说太小。
lines.en: Your strength is nothing to this shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪开一点，给你让路。
lines.en: I shift a little to let you pass.

lines.zh: 碰撞在我这里，几乎没有回音。
lines.en: Impact here has almost no echo.

lines.zh: 我在海底占了很大一块地方。
lines.en: I take up a large patch of seabed.

lines.zh: 你的脚步踩到我的边缘了。
lines.en: Your steps have reached my edge.

lines.zh: 我一侧转，水就把你推开了。
lines.en: One turn of my shell and the water shoves you.
I've carried this shell for centuries.

lines.zh: 另一枚巨大的螺靠近了。
lines.en: Another great shell draws near.

lines.zh: 我们的螺纹一圈圈对上。
lines.en: Our spirals align ring by ring.

lines.zh: 深海里，这样的相遇很稀罕。
lines.en: Such meetings are rare in the deep.
We settle together by the reef.
Its shell shine is a little brighter than mine.
I turn my shell mouth toward it.

lines.zh: 这片海床，够我们留住后代。
lines.en: This seabed can hold our offspring.
The water pressure pushes us slowly together.

lines.zh: 几百年里，我等的就是这样。
lines.en: In centuries, this is what I waited for.
Be still; let this moment last.
I lift it with my chisel foot.
What sinks to the bottom counts as mine.
I draw it into my shell.
It's hard; I'll wear it down slowly.

lines.zh: 我把它压在一层螺纹上。
lines.en: I press it against a ridge of my shell.
This will keep me chewing a long time.

lines.zh: 我把它卷进螺纹里，慢慢收好。
lines.en: I roll it into my whorl and stow it away.
It glows faintly; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把它推回去藏着。
lines.en: I slowly push it back to hide it.
Scavenging the seabed is my specialty.
That thing moves; I'll look.
I aim my shell mouth that way.
That's today's prey.

lines.zh: 我的凿足已经伸出去了。
lines.en: My chisel foot is already out.
Once locked, I don't change target.
It will swim into my reach.
I set the rules of this sea.
I press slowly closer.

lines.zh: 没有谁能穿过我的位置。
lines.en: No one crosses my position.
I choose that one.
It can't escape the deep sea.
I begin to prepare.
It's come too near my shell.
I hear it struggling.
Good, that one.
In this fight, the ground favors me.

lines.zh: 我这身壳，四十四点护甲。
lines.en: This shell carries forty-four armor.
No hurry; I have all the time.

lines.zh: 啃着海床，一步步缩短距离。
lines.en: Gnawing the seabed, step by step I close in.
It can't get around my shell.
I stretch my chisel foot ahead.

lines.zh: 螺口转向它，壳里传出磨石声。
lines.en: My shell mouth turns to it; grinding sounds from inside.
I calculate, and I calculate slowly.
It's badly panicked; I can hear it.
There is no second road here.
I open my shell mouth a bit wider.
It has backed to the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 我的凿足一寸寸碾碎脚下礁石。
lines.en: My drill foot grinds the reef to pieces inch by inch.
I needn't charge; walking will do.
My position blocks it exactly.

lines.zh: 它每喘一口气，我就近一点。
lines.en: With each breath it takes, I gain ground.
The deep sea is my ground.
I lift my shell to cover it.
This blow has long been ready.
About right; this is the spot.
Water pressure will do half my work.
I measure the distance one last time.
That will do; now.
I chisel down and the stone breaks.

lines.zh: 我这壳体一压，什么都扁了。
lines.en: My shell presses down and everything flattens.
A water shot pierces its shell.
I draw it into my shell mouth.

lines.zh: 这一撞，深海里传得很远。
lines.en: That impact carries far in the deep.
I brace it with my chisel foot.
It cannot move beneath my shell.

lines.zh: 我的重量，就是我的武器。
lines.en: My weight is my weapon.
I used thirty percent on that.
The rim of my shell mouth cut it open.
The pressure deforms it.
Slowly now; I will grind through.
The reef moved along with me.
At last it quiets.
I rise slowly from the deep.
The seabed sinks and I emerge.
The perfect shell appears.

lines.zh: 我这具壳，比这片礁还老。
lines.en: My shell is older than this reef.

lines.zh: 水流绕着我的螺纹打转。
lines.en: The current spirals around my shell.

lines.zh: 我一出现，海底就沉了半寸。
lines.en: When I arrive, the seabed sinks half an inch.

lines.zh: 你唤我出来，是想要什么？
lines.en: You called me out; what do you want?
I turn my shell mouth toward you.

lines.zh: 这么大的壳体，藏不住的。
lines.en: A shell this size cannot hide.

lines.zh: 深海的重量，都压在我身上。
lines.en: The weight of the deep rests on me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢向上，先看清四周。
lines.en: I rise slowly and read my surroundings.

lines.zh: 几百年的沉默，到此为止。
lines.en: Centuries of silence end here.
My armor needs no guard.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，太靠水边了。
lines.en: You stand too close to the water.

lines.zh: 我一动，整片海域都跟着。
lines.en: When I move, the whole sea follows.

lines.zh: 让我看看，值不值得我起身。
lines.en: Let me see if it's worth rising.

lines.zh: 我不吼叫，壳体就是声音。
lines.en: I don't roar; my shell is the sound.
I'm here; take it slowly.
An ancient of the deep comes ashore.
I claim this stretch of seabed first.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的螺壳，热得发烫。
lines.en: Fire roasts my spiral shell until it's hot.

lines.zh: 我从崖上坠下，壳重重砸进沙里。
lines.en: I fall from the ledge, my shell slamming into sand.

lines.zh: 在这么深的水里，我竟也呛住了。
lines.en: Even at this depth, I manage to choke.

lines.zh: 爆风把整片海床掀了起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole seabed.

lines.zh: 一枚投掷物砸在我的螺线上。
lines.en: A projectile strikes my spiral ridge.

lines.zh: 这股光穿进壳里，我的肉都僵了。
lines.en: The light pierces my shell and my flesh stiffens.
Starved too long, my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 雷顺着螺纹走，一路烧到壳口。
lines.en: Lightning runs my ridges down to the shell mouth.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水压，我的壳在发胀。
lines.en: No pressure in the void; my shell swells.
